Frequently Asked Questions

How do I fill the UG exam form for Wazirganj College?

Magadh University student login portal: magadhonline.in / magadhonline.com

What is the last date for the Sem-III (2025-29) exam form?

The last date for the Sem-III (U.G. Session 2025-29) exam form is 14/11/2026.

What is the last date for the Sem-V (2024-28) exam form?

The last date for the Sem-V (U.G. Session 2024-28) exam form is 17/11/2026.

What is the last date for the Sem-VII (2023-27) exam form?

The last date for the Sem-VII (U.G. Session 2023-27) exam form is 19/11/2026. University portal abhi khula nahi hai — portal khulte hi suchit kiya jayega; abhi sirf Sem-V aur Sem-III ke form bhare ja rahe hain.

Where can I check my Magadh University result and download my marksheet?

Result / Marksheet — Magadh University result portal. Registration No. and Exam Roll No. required.

🎓 Admission Form — Required Details

EdMitr Portal पर Admission Form भरने से पहले नीचे दी गई जानकारी और Documents तैयार रखें।

Admission Portal

1. Student Details

  • Aadhaar Number
  • APAAR ID
  • Caste Category

2. Parent Details

  • Father/Parent Name
  • Parent's Aadhaar Number

3. Address Details

  • Village/Post
  • Police Station
  • District
  • PIN Code
  • State

4. Subject Details

  • MIC Subject Choice (जहाँ लागू हो)

5. Previous Academic Document

  • Previous Admit Card
  • PDF format
  • File size: Less than 1 MB

6. Bank Details

  • Bank Name
  • Branch
  • Account Number
  • IFSC Code
Note: Requirements may differ by session. The college notice and admission-form instructions for your session are final — please follow those instructions for your session.

Note: Fill only the required information. Last date is as per each session's college notice — check the latest notice on the website before going.

Fill Exam Form — Magadh University

Magadh University Student Dashboard के माध्यम से Exam Form भरें। Form भरने से पहले नीचे दी गई जानकारी और Documents तैयार रखें।

Open Magadh University Student Dashboard www.magadhonline.in/student/dashboard

Login Details

User IDअपना Admit Card Number डालें। यह "23G00..." से शुरू होता है।
Passwordअपने नाम के पहले 4 letters CAPITAL में + Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY)
ExampleName: Veeru Verma · DOB: 11 May 2005 · Password:VEER11052005

⚠️ Login details किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति के साथ share न करें।

Exam Form भरने के लिए क्या चाहिए?

  • Previous Admit Card
  • Registration Number
  • Name & Date of Birth
  • Online Fee PaymentUPI · Debit/Credit Card
  • Filled Exam Form / Payment ReceiptForm submit करने के बाद receipt/printout सुरक्षित रखें।

Form भरने से पहले

  • Dashboard में Exam Form का option दिखाई दे तो form भरें।
  • अगर Exam Form का option नहीं दिखाई दे रहा है, तो college validation/activation का इंतज़ार करें।
  • Form submit करने के बाद Receipt/Printout सुरक्षित रखें।
  • Last Date: अपने Session की latest college notice के अनुसार देखें।
